item.title: GitTube weekly digest: week 45, 2026 (2–8 Nov 2026)
item.description:
The best of GitHub this week (2–8 Nov 2026), picked from GitTube's lanes. This entry is refreshed daily until the week ends.

Rising fastest

  1. storytold/craft-anything (Rust) ★ 21,583, +2,438 this day: Craft Anything: understand how any software works, and craft your own.
  2. anomalyco/rune (Rust) ★ 4,179, +1,252 this day: Rune: Native UI framework
  3. Minireel/HGhub (TypeScript) ★ 2,660, +752 this day: YellowFruit third-party client
  4. Gathin23/cleanyourtv (Python) ★ 54,182, +651 this day: Debloat any Android or Google TV over Wi-Fi and get an Apple TV-style home.
  5. JenkinWoo/sheeridVerify (JavaScript) ★ 1,797, +502 this day

Today

  • Th0rgal/satmux (Python) ★ 697: Accelerate high-latency GEO inflight Wi-Fi via warm BBR TCP multiplexing + 1-RTT Ground-TLS + zlib (zero dependencies)
  • MuseumCassowaryCarve/twitch-drops-miner (Python) ★ 425: Auto-farm Twitch drops in the background. Claim rewards, switch channels, and mine timed drops with zero video download. Lightweight AFK min
  • Poltergeistlunagrid/Steam-Idler (Python) ★ 425: Steam Idler, Card Farmer & Playtime Booster. Idle multiple games to farm trading cards, boost playtime hours, and manage multiple accounts.

This week

  • KKKKhazix/agent-autoloop (TypeScript) ★ 4,034: 让你的命令行 Agent 在后台自己接活、自己跟进到底；平时不烦你，遇到拿不准的事才发卡片找你拍板。
  • worldonlyu/Google_AI_Pro_2Year_ZeroCost_Auto (Python) ★ 3,167: Google_AI_Pro_2Year_ZeroCost_Auto
  • govijr/terminal-mac (Swift) ★ 2,315: Entire MacOS running in your terminal.

Python

  • deepseek-ai/DeepInfer (Python) ★ 25,641: DeepInfer: High-performance, large-scale inference framework for DeepSeek models
  • seedds/nxnative (Python) ★ 13,518: Switch games running natively on iPhone, iPad and Mac: an NSP folder becomes an unsigned IPA (NSO rewriter, Horizon HLE host, NVN→Metal)
  • xiaoyang111222/cn-math-taxonomy (Python) ★ 7,060: 数学（小学到高中）、英语（三年级到高中）、初中物理的知识图谱：1644 个知识点、2403 条先修边、6723 道题，对齐课标，附自适应前置诊断。

Rust

  • liseami/CCBaga (Rust) ★ 3,470
  • xevrion/hatchzip (Rust) ★ 2,653: HatchZip is a free, open-source archive extractor for Windows, macOS and Linux that extracts ZIP, 7z, RAR, tar and split archives in place,
  • opengeos/RustGIS (Rust) ★ 2,443: A fast, free and open-source GIS in pure Rust.

Telecom

  • absmach/magistrala (Go) ★ 2,660: IoT Platform Framework
  • Community-VyProjects/VyManager (TypeScript) ★ 495: Multi-tenant network management platform to configure, deploy, and monitor VyOS instances across multiple sites.
  • praetorian-inc/nerva (Go) ★ 378: Fast service fingerprinting CLI for 170+ protocols (TCP/UDP/SCTP) - built by Praetorian

5G

  • taubyte/tau (Go) ★ 5,166: Fullstack Workspace for Humans & Machines
  • open5gs/open5gs (C) ★ 2,808: Open5GS is a C-language Open Source implementation for 5G Core and EPC, i.e. the core network of LTE/NR network (Release-19)
  • free5gc/free5gc (Go) ★ 2,372: Open source 5G core network based on 3GPP R17
